nodes.description: External payable Play(string _response); checks msg.sender==tx.origin, verifies keccak256(_response)==responseHash, msg.value>0.01 ether and !closed, then transfers the whole balance to msg.sender and marks the game closed.
Public payable StartGame(string _question,string _response); sets responseHash from _response, stores _question and records questionSender = msg.sender.
Public payable StopGame(); restricted to questionSender, sets closed via GiftHasBeenSent and transfers the whole balance when msg.value > 0.01 ether.
Public payable NewQuestion(string _question, bytes32 _responseHash); restricted to questionSender, rewrites question and responseHash.
Private GiftHasBeenSent(); sets the closed flag to true.
Fallback function () public payable; accepts plain ether transfers without any logic.
string public question; the current quiz question text.
address questionSender; the account allowed to stop the game or set a new question.
bool public closed = false; guard flag that blocks further Play calls once the prize is sent.
bytes32 responseHash; hash of the expected answer used to validate Play submissions.
msg.sender; attacker controlled caller used for authorization checks and as the transfer recipient.
tx.origin; used in the Play authorization require(msg.sender == tx.origin) check.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) inside Play; external value transfer that executes before the closed flag is set.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) inside StopGame; external value transfer reaching an attacker controlled address.
string _response parameter of Play; hashed and compared against responseHash.
string _question parameter of StartGame; stored into the question state variable.
string _response parameter of StartGame; hashed into responseHash.
string _question parameter of NewQuestion; overwrites the question state variable.
bytes32 _responseHash parameter of NewQuestion; overwrites responseHash.
